glosses: im Gespräch zwischen Angebot und Nachfrage zu einem niedrigeren Preis kommen als ursprünglich verlangt

examples.text: Nicht mit mir! Ich habe sie natürlich heruntergehandelt.
Ich konnte den Preis um 50 Euro herunterhandeln.
Lassen Sie sich auf keinen Fall herunterhandeln!

translations.source_sense_description: einen niedrigeren Preis für etwas verhandeln

glosses: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see beat, down.

examples.text: The transmission tower was beaten down by the storm.

glosses: To forcefully diminish the power or influence of; to quell; to squash.

examples.text: The government tried to beat down the opposition movement.

glosses: (of the sun) To shine brightly and radiate with intense heat.

examples.text: We had to leave the beach because the sun was really beating down.

glosses: (of rain) To strike with great force.

examples.text: It was a ghastly morning, with the rain beating down in sheets.

glosses: To wear (someone) out by repeated actions that overwhelm one's patience or strength.

examples.text: She continued to badger until his friend did what he said. Eventually, she beat him down and he gave in.

glosses: To haggle with (someone) to sell at a lower price.

examples.text: I managed to beat him down to half his original asking price.
We beat the price down to 50 dollars.
